title: Launch host provisioning
summary: The approved host specification and region are confirmed, but authenticated provider access is unavailable.
evidence: The current host region was verified.
The new host minimum is four virtual CPUs, eight GiB RAM, and at least eighty GiB disk.
No local provider token is configured and the provider browser session is signed out.
The current production host remains live and unchanged.
limitations: Provisioning resumes only through a locally authenticated provider session. Credentials will not be requested or transmitted through chat.
